title: Proxy & Redis
description: The active proxy (requests, errors, latency, senders, process) and its Redis (through the proxy VIP)

panels.title: Critical firing
panels.description: Critical alerts firing now (all components). Details in the table and on Prometheus's Alerts page.

panels.title: Warnings firing
panels.description: Warning alerts firing now (all components).

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Every alert firing now, critical first. 'Firing for' counts from when the condition started (including the rule's wait time). History: the Alert log dashboard.

targets.expr: max by (alertname, severity, subject) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace((ALERTS{alertstate="firing",severity="critical"} * 3 or ALERTS{alertstate="firing",severity="warning"} * 2 or ALERTS{alertstate="firing"}), "subject", "$1", "instance", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "host", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "address", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "sender", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "node", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "section", "(.+)"))

max by (alertname, severity, subject) ((time() - label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(ALERTS_FOR_STATE, "subject", "$1", "instance", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "host", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "address", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "sender", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "node", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "section", "(.+)")) and on(alertname, severity, subject) label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(ALERTS{alertstate="firing"}, "subject", "$1", "instance", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "host", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "address", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "sender", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "node", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "section", "(.+)"))

panels.title: Proxy (the active one, through the proxy VIP)
Proxy
panels.description: Prometheus reaches the proxy through the proxy VIP

panels.title: 5xx errors
panels.description: Share of answers with status 5xx (the proxy failed). 4xx are the caller's mistakes and are not counted here

panels.title: Latency p95
panels.description: 95th percentile answer time, without /createaccount and /admin (MPC key generation is slow by design)

panels.title: In flight
panels.description: Requests being answered now

panels.title: Redis link
panels.description: The proxy's connection to its Redis (nonce cache). Without it the proxy continues with memory + chain

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Since the proxy started: a reset means a restart or a failover to the other host

panels.title: Requests per second by route
panels.description: Route patterns (e.g. /nft/:tokenId), all methods and status codes

panels.title: Errors per second (4xx and 5xx)
panels.description: 5xx: the proxy failed. 4xx: refused (bad input, wrong key, not allowed). aborted: the client hung up before the answer

panels.title: 95th percentile by route
panels.description: Includes /createaccount and /admin routes (MPC key generation)

panels.title: Routes in the selected time range
panels.description: Per route over the dashboard's time range (counts are estimates from Prometheus increase())

panels.title: Senders (every account the proxy sends from; filter with Kind, Section and Search above)
Senders
panels.description: Accounts the proxy sends from and watches (SENDER01, contract center, registry admin, section accounts, user accounts used in the last few minutes), matching the filters

targets.expr: count((max by (sender, account, kind, section) (proxy_sender_info{kind=~"$kind",section=~"$section",account=~"(?i).*$search.*"}) or max by (sender, account, kind, section) (proxy_sender_info{kind=~"$kind",section=~"$section",sender=~"(?i).*$search.*"}))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Stalled
panels.description: Ready transactions not mined while blocks are produced (alert ProxySenderStalled)

targets.expr: count((max by (sender) (proxy_sender_stalled) * on(sender) group_left(account, kind, section) (max by (sender, account, kind, section) (proxy_sender_info{kind=~"$kind",section=~"$section",account=~"(?i).*$search.*"}) or max by (sender, account, kind, section) (proxy_sender_info{kind=~"$kind",section=~"$section",sender=~"(?i).*$search.*"}))) == 1) or vector(0)

panels.title: Nonce gaps
panels.description: A nonce is missing: later transactions wait (alert ProxyNonceGap after 120 s)

targets.expr: count((max by (sender) (proxy_sender_gap_seconds) * on(sender) group_left(account, kind, section) (max by (sender, account, kind, section) (proxy_sender_info{kind=~"$kind",section=~"$section",account=~"(?i).*$search.*"}) or max by (sender, account, kind, section) (proxy_sender_info{kind=~"$kind",section=~"$section",sender=~"(?i).*$search.*"}))) > 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Check failing
panels.description: The proxy's chain check of the sender failed (alert ProxySenderCheckFailing)

targets.expr: count((max by (sender) (proxy_sender_check_error) * on(sender) group_left(account, kind, section) (max by (sender, account, kind, section) (proxy_sender_info{kind=~"$kind",section=~"$section",account=~"(?i).*$search.*"}) or max by (sender, account, kind, section) (proxy_sender_info{kind=~"$kind",section=~"$section",sender=~"(?i).*$search.*"}))) == 1) or vector(0)

panels.title: In flight
panels.description: Transactions sent and not mined yet, all matching senders

targets.expr: sum((max by (sender) (proxy_sender_inflight_transactions) * on(sender) group_left(account, kind, section) (max by (sender, account, kind, section) (proxy_sender_info{kind=~"$kind",section=~"$section",account=~"(?i).*$search.*"}) or max by (sender, account, kind, section) (proxy_sender_info{kind=~"$kind",section=~"$section",sender=~"(?i).*$search.*"})))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Waiting above gap
panels.description: Transactions in Besu's pool waiting for a missing nonce

targets.expr: sum((max by (sender) (proxy_sender_waiting_above_gap) * on(sender) group_left(account, kind, section) (max by (sender, account, kind, section) (proxy_sender_info{kind=~"$kind",section=~"$section",account=~"(?i).*$search.*"}) or max by (sender, account, kind, section) (proxy_sender_info{kind=~"$kind",section=~"$section",sender=~"(?i).*$search.*"})))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Repairs (range)
panels.description: Nonce gaps the proxy repaired in the selected time range

targets.expr: round(sum((sum by (sender) (increase(proxy_sender_nonce_repairs_total[$__range])) * on(sender) group_left(account, kind, section) (max by (sender, account, kind, section) (proxy_sender_info{kind=~"$kind",section=~"$section",account=~"(?i).*$search.*"}) or max by (sender, account, kind, section) (proxy_sender_info{kind=~"$kind",section=~"$section",sender=~"(?i).*$search.*"}))))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Fillers (range)
panels.description: 0-value filler transactions sent to close gaps in the selected time range

targets.expr: round(sum((sum by (sender) (increase(proxy_sender_filler_transactions_total[$__range])) * on(sender) group_left(account, kind, section) (max by (sender, account, kind, section) (proxy_sender_info{kind=~"$kind",section=~"$section",account=~"(?i).*$search.*"}) or max by (sender, account, kind, section) (proxy_sender_info{kind=~"$kind",section=~"$section",sender=~"(?i).*$search.*"}))))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Senders needing attention

(max by (sender) (proxy_sender_stall_seconds) * on(sender) group_left(account, kind, section) (max by (sender, account, kind, section) (proxy_sender_info{kind=~"$kind",section=~"$section",account=~"(?i).*$search.*"}) or max by (sender, account, kind, section) (proxy_sender_info{kind=~"$kind",section=~"$section",sender=~"(?i).*$search.*"})))

(max by (sender) (proxy_sender_gap_seconds) * on(sender) group_left(account, kind, section) (max by (sender, account, kind, section) (proxy_sender_info{kind=~"$kind",section=~"$section",account=~"(?i).*$search.*"}) or max by (sender, account, kind, section) (proxy_sender_info{kind=~"$kind",section=~"$section",sender=~"(?i).*$search.*"})))

panels.title: In flight: top 10 senders
